There is an extraordinary wealth of established truths about whole numbers;
                these truths provoke sheer awe for the beautiful complexity of prime num-
                bers. But each of the important new discoveries we make gives rise to a further
                richness of questions, educated guesses, heuristics, expectations, and unsolved
                problems.
